tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor yid bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor yid bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang rdo rje chos rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang po'i gsung / /legs 'ong paṇa chen kirti'i zhal sgo nas/ /rim brgyud legs pa'i 'byung gnas gsung rab cha/ /rje btsun mus pa'i gsung dang mi 'gal bar/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa yis/ /'chad par 'gyur gyis rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams/ /snyom las ma byed legs bshad ri mor bris/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub phyir phyogs brgyar spel/ /'dir 'khor lo bde mchog pa'i lugs kyis/ sbyin bya bzhi sbyin nas/ lam nyams su len pa yin pa las/ thog mar slob dpon nag po pa'i lugs kyi phyi dkyil du smin byed kyi cho ga dang / phyi dkyil nyams su len tshul rgyas pa dang / rdzogs rim shin tu rgyas pa lam gyi cha tshang ba zhig gsungs pa yin la/ phyi dkyil bsgoms pas snod bcud rags pa lhar gsal bas/ phyi nang cha mnyam par bsgom pa la lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs par/ gnyis ka mnyam par brtan zhing brtan pa thob pas/ nang dkyil gtso bor byed pa'i dbang du byas nas dril bu pa 'dir lus dkyil gtso bor gsungs so/ /mdzad pa po'i rim pa ltar na/ dang por lū hi pa/ de nas dril bu pa/ de nas nag po pa'o/ /nag po par ni bskyed rim dngos bstan/ rdzogs rim sbas don du bshad la/ lū hi pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ rtsa dbu ma nyid yin yang / bla ma mal lo sogs kyis yum la gtso bor sbyor ba'i lugs su mdzad do/ /dril bu pa 'dir ni/ bskyed rim sbas don/ rdzogs rim dngos bstan yin no/

/de yang spyir phyi dkyil las lus dkyil zab pa'i tshul ni/ phyi dkyil gyis bde chen gyi ye shes brgyud nas 'dren pa yin la/ 'dir dngos su 'dren pas so/ /lus dkyil la'ang / 'khor lo gcig la gnad du bsnun pa dang / gnyis la bsnun pa a bhi dha na las gsungs/ gsum la gnad du bsnun pa rdo rje phreng bar gsungs/ bzhi la bsnun pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gsungs/ lnga la bsnun pa/ saṃ ṭir gsungs/ drug la bsnun pa rdo rje snying 'grel las gsungs so/ /'dir ni a bhi dha na las gsungs pa dang mthun zhing / phyi skor sogs khyad par yod do/ /yang sgrol ma lus dkyil/ bdag med ma'i lus dkyil sogs kyang 'di zab cing / kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil las kyang / rtsa khams gnyis ka la gnad du bsnun pa 'di nyid mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /mdor na bskyed rim lus la gnad du bsnun pa la/ 'di las zab pa sangs rgyas kyis gsung ma mkhyen to/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams gsungs ngo / /lha sbyin gyi slob tshul gyi sgo nas kyang zab ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'dis/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro ba thams cad 'di yis khyab/ /ces dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ padma'i mtsho la ngang pa bzhin/ /dam tshig gnas la mkha' 'gro rnams/ /ring na gnas kyang de dang der/ /zhes pa dang / yul 'di dag ni bu mo gang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /de kun 'dod pa'i gzugs can te/ /yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /snga ma mkha' 'gro chos sku'i khyab pa'i don no/ /yang 'di lta bu'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyud gzhan du ma gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor 'dir ni dbang bskur ba/ /rgyud rnams kun gyis sgrub por gsungs/ /rgod dang lta ba lag bcang dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa la sogs dag /rgyud rnams kun du ma gsungs te/ /de nyid bsdus pa 'khor sdom mam/

/gsang ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi cho ga 'di/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ de la dang po rnams kyi bya spyod sogs/ 'khor sdom 'dir kyai rdo rje la btags pa'o/ /'o na lus la bsgom pa rang gang gis bstan zhe na/ 'di la rtsa rgyud du sbas te bshad pa'i tshul dang / bshad rgyud du 'thor bu'i tshul gyis bshad pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'khor lo bzhi la bsgom tshul ni/ mkha' 'gro ma ni sogs nas/ 'di dag sngon nyid grub pa yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /sngon nyid grub pa'i don ni/ rtsa khams sogs rang bzhin gyis gdod ma nas lha'i ngo bor grub ces pa'o/ /lus dang rtsa sogs dus mtshungs tsam la 'dod pa ni/ nges don la kha phyir bltas pa'o/ /sku gsum lam du byed pa ni/ de nas he ru ka gnyis med/ /sbyor ba gang gis shes tsam gyis/ /grub par the tshom med pa yis/ /sku gsum po ni bshad par bya/ /sogs nas/ 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa'o/ /rten gzhal yas khang ni/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na sogs/ 'dis rten ston pa'i rgyu mtshan saṃ ṭir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ skyabs sems/ yi ge brgya pa sogs sngon du song nas/ he ru kar ldang ba nas/ sku'i dga' ba'i bar a bhi dha na las gsungs/ tshogs shing spyan drangs mchod bstod sogs kun spyod las gsungs/ 'phags pas tshogs zhing bstim pa'i rkyen gyis/ lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa 'di/ kyai rdo rje'i skya bkab yin/ tshogs shing byin gyis rlob pa'i tshul gyis bstim pa/ dril bu gzhung chung nas yod pas de ltar ram/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje sogs rten lus dkyil saṃ ṭi las bshad la/ phyi nang gi he ru ka gnyis rim gyis gsal 'debs gong ma mdzad/ 'phags pas cig car mdzad pa 'di gzhung rang dang mthun shas shin tu che bas/ cig car du bya/ yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams lhar bsgom pa/ lha grangs sogs saṃ ṭi las bshad/

yan lag kha ṭwaṃ ga sbyor bas sogs kyis phyag mtshan bstan no/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i zhal phyag rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ 'di nag po pas dpyid thig su'ang drangs so/ /yang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i rtsa gnas ni/ saṃ ṭi las/ 'byung bzhi'i rtsa rnams ni/ /mar me'i rang bzhin lta bu ni/ /phyogs bzhi las ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa yin la/ 'di dag gzhir gnas la/ phyogs sangs rgyas lnga/ mtshams yum bzhi laṃ dang maṃ sogs yod la/ 'dir maṃ laṃ sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis rim pas bstan/ snga ma'i ltar byas pa'ang bzhir gnas dbang gis mi 'gal lo/ /des na gang zin nas mdzad pa'o/ /mtshams kyi bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar bskyed pa ni/ rtsa rnams bzhi yang mtshams rnams su/ /rnam par gnas shing der song pa'ang / /bdud rtsi lnga yi 'bab pa ste/ /de mchod rang gi gzugs gnas pas/ /de yi dngos po'i ngo bo las/ /mchod pa bzhi ni rnam par brjod/ /ces pas so/ /yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams lhar ston pa ni/ lus dkyil sogs nas/ sha dang / snabs ni 'bab pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ he ru ka ni/ /snying ga'i nang son padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /mar me yi ni rang bzhin dang / /chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/ /brkyang zhing kha ni 'og tu'o/ /de yi nang gnas dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ /mi shigs hūm̐ gi sa bon ni/ /kha ba lta bur 'dzag pa nyid/ /ces sogs te/ 'di dag bstan tshul yin no/ /rdzogs rim gyi rtag tu snying la rnam gnas pa'i sogs/ a bhi dha na'i rgyud tshig yin/ rim pa lnga las gang yang rung pa/ bskyed rim rjes su rgyun par bsgom par gsungs kyang / snga ma 'di nyid sgrub thabs su 'byung ba nyams su len no/ /'di la dmigs pa gsal bar gtod pa tsam las rlung kha sbyor sogs bsgom pa mi bya/

gzhan rnams 'phags pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs su blta'o/ /rang gis thob nas nyams su len pa'i gnad/ /rgyud ldan gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thungs pa na/ /yid la dang pa dpag med thob pa rnams/ /brjed pas 'jigs nas cha tsam bris pa la/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod mdzod cing / /bsgrub la bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang / /mi mthun rkyen rnams ma lus phyir bsal te/ /gnyis med sbyor ldan zung 'jug mthong bar shog /bdag ni tshe 'dir he ru kar gyur tam/ /yang na skye ba skye bar chos tshul 'di'i/ /rjes 'brang bla ma dam pa bsten pa'i mthus/ /'gro kun yang dag lam gyi sar bcud de/ /stobs sogs yon tan dpag med bsgrub par shog /ces slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor yid bde'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di yang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las skyes pa'i bde mchog gsang mtha'i rnal 'byor sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don phal cher yid yul du 'jags par byas pa'i tshe zab gnad kyi yi ge 'di yang rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i gsung dang mthun par mthong nas rang gzhan gyi don du bris pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lus dkyil gyi lung sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
